contexts.text: Trumpeters () = the goods of faith.
To sound with the trumpet is a spiritual expression.
To sound with the trumpet () = to announce that the Intellectual of the Church (Ephraim) has been desolated.
The trumpet, which was a wind instrument with a loud sound, corresponded to the affection of celestial good. (See Jobel.)
The voice of a trumpet exceeding loud () = the celestial state which was around; for the voice, or sound, of a trumpet = the truth of celestial good; voice = truth; and trumpet, celestial good.

Truth Divine itself in Heaven is signified by voices and lightnings; but heavenly or angelic truth adjoined to the Divine, which is below or around, is signified by the voice of a trumpet. Illustrated. AC 8823.
The voice of a trumpet () = Divine truths from good through Heaven; for the voice of a trumpet = the state of the angelic Heaven which is around the Divine; and also the truth Divine thence.
The voice of a trumpet () = truth Divine through Heaven in an internal form, and its evangelization. HH 1:2.
[Swedenborg footnote 12.]. That a trumpet = Divine truth in Heaven, and revealed from Heaven. References.
Trumpets and drums corresponded to celestial goods and truths.
The voice, or sound, of pipers and trumpeters () has relation to celestial affections. Explained. ( = the affection of celestial truth and good. AR 792.) AE 1185.
The voice of a trumpet = Divine truth as to revelation.
He shall sound with the trumpet () = a manifest perception of good.
A day of the trumpet and of sounding () = spiritual combat, which is against falsities and evils.
Sound with the trumpet () = worship.
To sound the trumpet () = combat against that Church from the truths which are from good.
The sound of the trumpet = Divine truth making glad the heart. Illustrated.
To sound with the trumpet () = to disperse by means of Divine truth.

As the evil, where gathered together in the Spiritual World, are, by the influx of Divine good and Divine truth, deprived of the truths and goods which they have simulated in externals, and are let into the evils and falsities which they have cherished within, and are thus separated from the good and cast into the Hells; and as, when this is done, there is heard by those at a distance as it were trumpets sounding, it was therefore commanded among the sons of Israel that they should sound with the trumpets for battle. Illustrated.
Convocation to the Church by the Lord, is signified by, In that day a great trumpet shall be sounded (). AE 741:10.
Trumpet = Divine truth to be revealed, or which has been revealed.
The sounding of the trumpets by the priests (at Jericho) = the preaching of Divine truth from Divine good. See AC 8815:2.
